profile.ja: 単独での危険な潜入任務を主とする手練の対魔忍。才色兼備の女性で６ヶ国語に通じ、２つの博士号と数十に渡る分野の専門知識を有し、あらゆる経歴の人物となって潜入可能という高度な隠密技術の持ち主。戦闘能力も高く忍法・木遁の術を使う。通称“花の静流”。植物を操り、特定の武器は持たず戦闘時は掌から強力な薔薇の鞭を出現させ操って戦う。物腰軽やかな大人の女性。妖艶な魅力で男性を魅了するのも潜入任務では欠かせない才能の一つだが、過剰に性衝動を誘発させる豊満すぎる肉体が悩みの種でもある。
profile.en: She is a seasoned Taimanin who specializes in dangerous solo infiltration missions. A talented and beautiful woman fluent in six languages, she holds two doctorates and possesses expert knowledge across dozens of fields, allowing her to assume any background and infiltrate with advanced stealth techniques. Her combat abilities are also high; she uses ninjutsu and wood-style techniques. Known as "Shizuru of the Flowers." She manipulates plants, carries no weapons, and summons a powerful rose-whip from her palm in battle. She carries herself with a light, adult grace. Her seductive charm is an essential asset for infiltration, effortlessly captivating men, but the overly voluptuous body that excessively provokes sexual urges is also a source of trouble for her.

text.ja: 花の静流、参上。この装備で呼び出すなんて、今回の任務はよっぽど重大なのね。だけど……そっちの方が、燃えるわ♪
text.en: Flower Shizuru, reporting. Summoning me with this equipment means the mission is pretty serious, huh? But... that just makes me even more excited.

text.ja: センサー類の無効化はまかせてちょうだい。それが科学製だろうと魔術製だろうと、両方を兼ね備えていようと、解除してみせるわ
text.en: Leave the sensor disabling to me. Whether it's scientific or magical, or a blend of both, I'll see to it that they're neutralized.

text.ja: 隠れても無駄よ～？　今の私は僅かな対魔粒子の揺らぎも見逃さないわ……ほら、いた。さあ、英語の補習授業を始めるわねぇ
text.en: Hiding is useless now~? I don't miss even the slightest fluctuation of Taimanin particles... there, I see you. Now, let's begin the English remedial class.

text.ja: いざという時はリミッターも外す覚悟はできているわ。その時は……あなたに私のしていた事、引き継いでもらおうかしら
text.en: When the time comes I'm ready to pull the limiter. Then... perhaps I'll have you inherit what I've been doing.

text.ja: ……くっ。いえ、気にしないでいいわ、この程度の反動は最初から想定内だもの。……うふふ、優しいのね。なら少し甘えようかしら
text.en: ...Ugh. No, don't worry about it, this level of recoil was expected from the start. ...Hehe, you're kind… then maybe I'll be a little spoiled.

text.ja: このスーツは科学技術と魔科医の技術を両立させた特別製よ。製作者を教えて欲しい？　ふふ、私を口説き落とせたら、ベッドの上でね
text.en: This suit is a special production that combines scientific and magical-medical technology. Want to know who made it? Hehe, if you can win me over, let's do it on the bed.

text.ja: この装備は、私の魔性をより一層高めているのよ。……もちろん、別の意味でもね。どう？　思い切ってアプローチしてみるかしら？
text.en: This gear really amps up my demonic side… of course, in more ways than one. How about it? Should I go in for a bold approach?

text.ja: ふー、頼られるのはいいけれど、こうも自分で何でもできちゃうと、行き遅れちゃうわね。どこかに将来有望な子、いないかしら、ね……
text.en: Phew, it's nice being relied on, but when I can do everything myself I end up falling behind. I wonder if there's any promising kid out there somewhere…

text.ja: あんっ、もう、イタズラはダメよ。感度の調査？　別にそっちの感度は関係ない……んっ、あ、こらぁ……そこが敏感なのは、最初からぁ
text.en: Ah, enough, no more teasing. Sensitivity test? That doesn't really matter… nngh, ah, hey… that spot's been sensitive from the start.

text.ja: お゛おおぉ～～～ん、いぐいぐぅ！　花の静流改めバカの静流っ、アホ面晒してハメ乞いアクメダンスしまぁ～す、チンポくださぁ～い♪
text.en: Ooooh—! I'm Shizuru of the Flowers, now the foolish Shizuru, flashing my stupid face and begging for an orgasm dance—give me your cock~♪

text.ja: んっはぁ……なぁに急にお腹を揉んで……ああっ、何言ってるの、あなたの子に決まってるでしょ。ひどいパパでちゅねぇ？　んんっ……
text.en: Nnh… what's with suddenly rubbing my belly… Ah, what are you saying? Of course it's your child. You're such a terrible dad, aren't you? Nnh…
